semantics.panel_rule: Each bounded cell of the M0 embedded dual graph corresponding to one internal primal vertex is a rigid planar body.
semantics.hinge_rule: Each internal primal edge defines an ideal revolute hinge between its two incident internal-vertex panels, with hinge axis equal to the embedded oriented-dual segment for that edge.
semantics.boundary_rule: Boundary primal edges are free boundary and create no additional body-hinge constraint.

hinge_constraint.geometry: For hinge endpoints p=(px,py,0), q=(qx,qy,0), let u=(q-p)/|q-p|=(ux,uy,0), and m=px*uy-py*ux.

matrix_contract.rank_method: SVD with absolute and relative singular-value diagnostics; retained rank threshold must be declared in output.
matrix_contract.root_invariance_check: Repeat baseline rank/nullity with each panel fixed; rank-derived mobility must agree.

stages.K1: flat-state infinitesimal mobility atlas over all retained valid M0 realizations
stages.K2: not pre-authorized; bounded local finite continuation only after separate K1 justification

falsification_targets: all retained TE3 realizations have the same flat-state infinitesimal mobility
the quotient point uniquely determines the flat-state infinitesimal kinematic state despite geometric branch multiplicity
